newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish chemical output seen up 1-2 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Finnish chemical output seen up 1-2 pct in 1996.

text.p: A Finnish chemical industry body said on Wednesday it expects 1996 production to increase one to two percent on 1995.
"Due to the low starting level, production will not increase more than one to two percent on last year," the Chemical Industry Federation of Finland said.
The federation said it expects its 1996 result after financial items to clearly improve on 1995, when it amounted to eight percent of net sales.
